ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, quadrilateral WXYZ is a rectangle, W is at the upper left, X is at the upper right, Y is at the lower left, and Z is at the lower right. Inside the rectangle, two diagonals YX and WZ are drawn, and they intersect. ∠1 is located at vertex X, and is the angle formed by diagonal YX and the upper side WX; ∠8 is located at vertex W, and is the angle formed by diagonal WZ and the upper side WX. Reasoning: Because WXYZ is a rectangle, it is symmetric about the vertical midline. When reflected along this vertical midline, X and W are interchanged, the upper side WX remains on itself, and diagonal YX will correspond to diagonal WZ. Therefore, the angle formed by diagonal YX and the upper side WX at X is equal to the angle formed by diagonal WZ and the upper side WX at W, namely ∠8 = ∠1. Given m∠1 = 30°, so m∠8 = 30°.

raw_record.question_text: Quadrilateral $WXYZ$ is a rectangle. Find the measure of $\angle 8$ if $m\angle 1 = 30$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a rectangle WXYZ with both diagonals drawn: diagonal YX creates angle 1 with the top side WX at vertex X, and diagonal WZ creates angle 8 with the same top side WX at vertex W. From the text, use that WXYZ is a rectangle and m∠1 = 30°. A rectangle has reflection symmetry across its vertical midline: this reflection sends X to W, keeps the top side WX on itself, and sends diagonal YX to diagonal WZ. Therefore the angle made by YX with WX at X equals the angle made by WZ with WX at W, so ∠8 = ∠1 = 30°.

推理：因为 WXYZ 是长方形，它关于竖直中线对称。沿这条竖直中线反射时，X 与 W 互换，上边 WX 保持在自身上，对角线 YX 会对应到对角线 WZ。因此，对角线 YX 与上边 WX 在 X 处形成的角等于对角线 WZ 与上边 WX 在 W 处形成的角，即 ∠8 = ∠1。已知 m∠1 = 30°，所以 m∠8 = 30°。

method.method_draft: From the image, form right triangle WXY using sides WX and WY and diagonal XY; angle 1 is the angle at X of this triangle. Also form right triangle XWZ using sides XW and XZ and diagonal WZ; angle 8 is the angle at W of this triangle. From the text, WXYZ is a rectangle, so WX is common to both triangles and WY = XZ as opposite sides of a rectangle, with right angles at W and X respectively. Thus triangles WXY and XWZ are congruent by leg-leg/SAS for right triangles. Corresponding acute angles ∠1 and ∠8 are congruent, so m∠8 = 30°.
